jobs.title: Product Manager, Developer Ecosystem
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. Itâs built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internetâs largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

About the Team

Reddit's developer ecosystem is one of the biggest opportunities to make Reddit more useful, expressive, extensible, and valuable. Today, most people who build on Reddit are developers: they write code, use Devvit, work with APIs, and ship apps or games through a relatively technical workflow. That ecosystem is growing quickly and remains critical.

But the future is bigger than developers alone. AI-assisted building is changing who can create software. The next generation of Reddit apps, games, tools, community agents, content formats, and workflows should be buildable by many more people: developers, technically curious creators, moderators, community builders, game designers, data partners, and eventually people who can describe what they want without needing to code it by hand.

The Developer Ecosystem team owns the product systems that help this broader set of builders discover opportunities, create successfully, launch high-quality apps and games, reach the right users and communities, adopt new platform capabilities, and keep improving after launch. This includes surfaces and systems like developers.reddit.com, AI-assisted creation, app review, developer and creator onboarding, app marketplace experiences, platform capabilities, best practices, and support for emerging creator categories.

About the Role

We are looking for a Staff Product Manager to lead Reddit's Builder Ecosystem product strategy. This person will define the roadmap for how Reddit moves from a developer-only ecosystem to a broader builder ecosystem where AI-assisted and no-code creation become first-class parts of the platform.

The role spans developer growth, creator onboarding, AI-assisted building, app quality, ecosystem incentives, platform capabilities, app marketplace strategy, operational tooling, feature adoption, and new builder categories.

This is a high-ambiguity platform role with direct business, product, and community impact. The right PM will be able to bridge two worlds: they should understand the needs of serious developers and platform engineers, while also having strong conviction that Reddit can unlock a much larger wave of builders by making creation more accessible, guided, AI-native, and outcome-oriented.

What You'll Do

  • Define the product strategy for Reddit's Developer Ecosystem, including the transition from code-first developers to a broader base of AI-assisted creators.
  • Own the roadmap for developers.reddit.com as the primary builder portal, including onboarding, docs, app management, analytics, review status, feature access, education, examples, templates, and AI-assisted creation entry points.
  • Lead strategy for AI-assisted app creation, including prompt-to-app workflows, AI building tools, no-code or low-code experiences, reusable templates, generated scaffolds, and systems that help creators turn ideas into useful Reddit-native apps.
  • Build the product approach for an App Marketplace that helps users, moderators, communities, and internal teams discover high-quality apps, games, agents, tools, and community experiences.
  • Improve app review and ecosystem operations through tooling, automation, and AI-assisted workflows, including LLM-powered app review, policy checks, quality signals, and reviewer efficiency.
  • Partner with Engineering to prioritize core platform capabilities and performance improvements such as webhooks, webviews, APIs, SDKs, tooling, observability, and other primitives builders need to create reliable apps.
  • Drive more successful, retentive, and popular apps and games by identifying best practices, improving templates, shaping incentives, and creating clearer paths from idea to launch to growth.
  • Identify and support new creator and developer categories
  • Partner with internal teams such as Contribution, Community Builders, Games, Search, Recommendations, Safety, and Ads to help them launch new functionality through the developer ecosystem.
  • Define and improve feature adoption programs so builders understand, test, and successfully use new platform capabilities.
  • Work with developer relations to establish the measurement system for the ecosystem, including weekly active developers/creators, NPS/CSAT, app launches, app retention and more
  • Create clear frameworks for when Reddit should build platform primitives, launch templates, fund builders, partner with external teams, promote apps, or shut down low-quality or low-trust ecosystem behavior.
  • Lead cross-functional alignment across Product, Engineering, DevRel, Community, Data, Safety, Legal, Policy, Support, BD, and senior leadership.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience leading high-ambiguity platform, developer ecosystem, creator ecosystem, marketplace, gaming, AI tooling, or developer experience products.
  • Strong product judgment for creation platforms: understanding what makes a platform powerful for advanced developers, approachable for new creators, trustworthy for communities, and worth sustained investment.
  • Comfort with code, APIs, developer tools, technical platform tradeoffs, and engineering conversations, paired with strong conviction that AI-assisted and no-code creation will expand who can build on Reddit.
  • Ability to reason across multiple sides of the ecosystem: developers, creators, users, moderators, communities, internal teams, partners, and Reddit's business priorities.
  • Experience improving developer or creator onboarding, docs, portals, SDKs, APIs, marketplaces, app review, app distribution, AI creation tools, or app-building workflows.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort defining metrics for ecosystem health, builder productivity, app quality, retention, distribution, and business impact.
  • Ability to partner deeply with Engineering on platform capabilities, performance, reliability, primitives, observability, and build-vs-buy decisions.
  • Strong product sense for apps, games, agents, content creation tools, community-native experiences, and the kinds of lightweight software that should exist inside Reddit communities.
  • Comfort working with AI-assisted creation tools, LLM-based workflows, prompt-to-app systems, or other emerging ways of helping more people build software.
  • Excellent written communication and decision frameworks that help teams make crisp investment decisions in ambiguous spaces.

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs
  • 401k with Employer Match
  • Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support
  • Family Planning Support
  • Gender-Affirming Care
  • Mental Health & Coaching Benefits
  • Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off
  • Generous Paid Parental LeaveÂ

Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. jobs.title: Sr. Forward Deployed Data Engineer
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

Natera is a global leader in cell-free DNA testing, serving patients across oncology, womenâs health, and organ health. Our Data & AI organization builds the enterprise data platform and AI systems that turn clinical, genomic, and operational data into products that improve patient care and accelerate the business.

We are looking for a Senior Forward Deployed Data Engineer to work directly with internal business stakeholders and domain teams to design, build, and deploy high-impact analytics and AI solutions. Reporting directly to the Data & AI Engineering Tech Lead, you will act as the technical point-of-contact and primary builder for stakeholder initiatives, translating business needs into production-ready data and AI products. This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role where you will write production code, develop semantic layers, and implement agentic workflows and LLM pipelines.

As a forward deployed engineer, you are AI-native by designâusing AI coding harnesses and agentic tooling to accelerate development, testing, and documentation. You will partner closely with the Tech Lead to adopt foundational architecture patterns while rapidly delivering tailored solutions in a regulated environment where data quality, lineage, and privacy are essential.

The ideal candidate combines strong engineering fundamentals with a customer-obsessed mindset, pragmatic problem-solving, and the communication skills needed to bridge complex technical solutions and business outcomes.

Â 

Key Responsibilities

Stakeholder Engagement & Technical Ownership

  • Embed closely with business stakeholders to deeply understand their data and AI requirements, serving as their primary technical advisor and engineer.
  • Run launch discovery and impact analysis for new assays or products (models, views, dashboards touched), documented in Confluence and Jira.
  • Translate complex business challenges into clear technical specs and deliverable milestones, partnering with the Tech Lead to align with enterprise architecture standards.
  • Adhere to established engineering standards for pipeline design, data modeling, testing, version control (Git/GitLab branching, MRs, PRs) and CI/CD, ensuring deployed solutions are reliable and maintainable.

Hands-On Solutions Engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and transformations on our cloud data platform, sourcing clinical, laboratory, operational, and commercial data to serve business analytics.
  • Develop governed data models and semantic layers that power self-service analytics, dashboards, and data products (e.g., Patient 360, Provider 360, Test 360) for business teams.
  • Develop AI solutions to enable business productivity and automation through use of agentic workflows, RAG/retrieval, and LLM pipelines (extraction/classification)
  • Write production-grade SQL and Python; contribute to shared frameworks, templates, and tooling that let the team deliver new analytics solutions faster.
  • Ensure the data layer supports performant, trustworthy analytics and LLM querying ; lead root-cause analysis on complex data issues and drive durable fixes.

Â 

AI-Native Execution & Continuous Learning

  • Leverage AI coding assistants and agentic tools daily across the full software development lifecycle to accelerate solution development and deployment speed.
  • Apply AI-native engineering best practicesâsuch as prompt engineering, agentic workflows, and automated testingâto maximize individual output while upholding high quality.
  • Collaborate with the Tech Lead and peer engineers through code reviews, technical sharing, and feedback to continually refine forward deployed engineering practices.

Data Quality, Reliability & Compliance

  • Implement data quality checks, contracts, lineage, and monitoring so that downstream consumers can trust the data by default.
  • Own operational excellence for the teamâs solutions: SLAs, incident response, and cost efficiency of compute and storage.
  • Ensure pipelines handling PHI and genomic data meet HIPAA, CLIA, and internal security and governance requirements, including access controls, auditability, and retention.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Work directly with business stakeholders across functions to understand their questions, shape analytics solutions to their needs, and communicate technical tradeoffs in plain language.
  • Collaborate with core platform and AI teams under the guidance of the Tech Lead to build solutions on enterprise foundations rather than isolated silos.
  • Represent the team in architecture forums, data governance discussions, and tool evaluations.

Â 

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years of data or software engineering experience, with a track record of forward-deployed or customer-facing engineering roles delivering analytics and AI solutions directly to stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to partner directly with non-technical business partners, translate technical concepts clearly, and manage project deliverables.
  • Demonstrated, hands-on use of AI coding assistants and agentic tools in daily engineering work, with a point of view on how to use them well.
  • Expert-level SQL and strong Python, with a track record of shipping and operating production data pipelines and data models at scale.
  • Deep experience with a modern cloud data warehouse and cloud infrastructure (Snowflake/AWS preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with transformation frameworks (dbt or equivalent) and workflow orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or similar).
  • 1-2 years of practical background building with LLM frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent) alongside managed AI services and model routing gateways like Snowflake Cortex, AWS Bedrock, and foundational APIs.
  • Strong grounding in analytical data modeling (dimensional or domain-driven), semantic layers, data quality engineering, and CI/CD for data systems.

Preferred

  • Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or another regulated domain handling PHI or other sensitive data.
  • Experience with lab data management systems, lab informatics systems, bioinformatics pipelines is a plus
  • Snowflake experience, including performance tuning, cost management, and features such as dynamic tables, Snowpark, or Cortex.
  • Sigma experience, or experience with comparable BI and semantic-layer tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI), and an understanding of how to design data models for self-service consumption.
  • Working knowledge of Power BI, including dataset design, data source connectivity, and troubleshooting dashboards when upstream data changes.
  • Experience building and operating agentic or LLM-based workflows within the data development lifecycle.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and data observability tooling.
  • Experience integrating with Salesforce, laboratory information systems, or EHR data sources.
  • Bachelorâs or Masterâs degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.
Remote USA

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Nateraâ¢ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, womenâs health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, youâll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, youâll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

jobs.title: Senior Database Engineer
jobs.description:
Â 

Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California. Learn more atÂ bitwarden.com.Â 

As a Senior Database Engineer at Bitwarden you will work with our Engineering teams to lead the design, development, and continual tuning and maintenance of our database systems.Â  You will serve as a technical leader for database query design and the optimization of our existing queries, scripts, and programs.Â  You will support the software development process and contribute directly to the culture of quality within Bitwarden through process improvements, team outreach, and mentoring. To ensure success as a Senior Database Engineer, you should exhibit knowledge of best practices in database management and experience in a similar role. A top-notch Senior Database Engineer will be someone whose database management skills translate into the efficient flow of information throughout an organization.

This is an all-remote team and we are looking for someone located in the U.S. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Maintain and enhance the performance of existing database scripts, queries, and other database objects
  • Assist engineering teams in designing new database implementations that meet the organization's data security, storage, and performance needs
  • Tune existing database scripts and queries for optimal performance and data security
  • Establish database observability practices and monitor databases and related systems to ensure optimized performance alongside operations staff
  • Partner with other engineers to develop new scripts and queries that support company growth
  • Review database and user reports as well as system information
  • Perform debugging procedures on database scripts and systems, including as a part of incident response
  • Mentor engineers and provide them with technical support
  • Adhere to best practices in securely accessing, storing, backing up, and archiving data
  • Document processes related to database design, configuration, and performance
  • Keep abreast of developments and best practices in database engineering
  • Participate in code reviews and learn and spread technical knowledge amongst the engineering organization

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

Must haves:

  • Expert knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL: execution plans, indexing, locking and blocking, and query tuning on very large tables
  • Experience reviewing other engineersâ database code (schema changes, stored procedures, queries, migrations) and giving clear, constructive feedback that developers act on
  • Experience making schema changes safely on live systems: backward-compatible migrations, zero-downtime deployments, and knowing which changes block
  • Experience operating a large, busy cloud-hosted database in production (Azure SQL preferred; equivalent experience on another managed platform is welcome)
  • Ability to diagnose performance problems with evidence, using tools such as Query Store, execution plans, and wait and blocking analysis
  • Excellent problem-solving skills: you might not know all the answers, but you know how to find and communicate the solution
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including explaining database findings to developers, SRE and support
  • Proficiency using source control and working through pull requests
  • Around 5 years of experience in database engineering, or equivalent depth on a large production system

Good to have:

  • Ability to read and review C# data-access code (.NET, Dapper, Entity Framework migrations)
  • Working knowledge of at least one other RDBMS, such as PostgreSQL or MySQL
  • Experience with observability tooling, such as Datadog and a telemetry query language like KQL
  • Scripting for automation in PowerShell or Python
  • Experience with production incident response and carrying out data fixes under a controlled process
  • Familiarity with Docker for local and test environments
  • Sound practice in data security: least-privilege access and safe handling of production data and secrets

Â 

WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Meeting with Talent Acquisition
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager
  • Interview with fellow database engineers

A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US

  • Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the worldâs largest organizations.
  • Become an expert. Youâll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.
  • We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.
  • Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join our #growth-club to continue personal and professional development.Â 

Â 

In the United States, the starting base compensation range for this role is $150,000 - $210,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, relevant experience, and skill set as assessed in the interview process, as well as market data by location. See our careers page for a list of benefits. Please note that compensation outside the U.S. will differ based on the market.

jobs.title: Staff Data Scientist - Martech Platform (ML/Algos)
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

Marketing Data Science Measurement empowers Airbnb to optimize marketing ROI through data-informed decision-making. We lead the way in defining and advancing best practices for measuring and optimizing marketing impact. We collaborate with Marketing, Finance, Engineering, and Product to provide actionable recommendations and tools based on effective, timely, and granular measurements.

The Difference You Will Make

As a Data Scientist working on algorithms on the Marketing Data Science team, you will develop the models and measurement behind Airbnbâs AI-driven marketing system where AI agents run campaigns within guardrails set by marketers. These systems shape how Airbnb acquires, retains, and re-engages its guest and host community across owned and paid channels. Your models will inform targeting, creative and spend across channels, audiences, and time.

We are seeking a senior technical leader in ML-driven marketing systems to serve as the data science technical lead across these efforts. You will guide the measurement and optimization approaches for these systems, help develop the models that power them, set the scientific bar, and raise the capability of the team and our partners.

  • Define with Marketing the objectives these systems optimize and the guardrails they operate within, so automated decisions on bids, budgets, audiences, content, and timing target incremental value rather than proxy metrics.
  • Lead the measurement strategy for these programs, combining channel, program, and campaign experiment results into a meta-analytic view of incremental impact.
  • Define how predictive models and causal measurement work together so budget decisions rest on both.
  • Drive large, ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives from problem framing through production.
  • Mentor and set technical standards for data scientists across the team.

A Typical Day:

  • Identify and prioritize the highest-value modeling and optimization opportunities across marketing, translating ambiguous business problems into multi-quarter scientific roadmaps.
  • Partner with Marketing, Finance, Engineering, and Product to align on metrics, methodology, and investment decisions.
  • Architect and review models and pipelines for batch and real-time decisions at scale, such as bidding and message selection; stay hands-on where it matters.
  • Define how automated decisions are evaluated before and after launch and the evidence a channel needs to move from marketer-approved proposals to autonomous operation.
  • Influence senior leadership with clear recommendations that include uncertainty and trade-offs.
  • Mentor DS teammates through design reviews, code reviews, and project scoping.
  • Use AI and agentic coding to improve the teamâs workflows and velocity.

Your Expertise:

  • 6+ years of relevant industry experience and a PhD in a quantitative field.
  • Track record of building and deploying machine learning models to optimize advertising outcomes that drive automated decisions at scale.
  • Experience designing experiments or incrementality measurement (e.g., holdouts, geo tests) for ML-driven decision systems.
  • Deep expertise in the ML lifecycle and algorithms: gradient boosted trees, probabilistic and Bayesian approaches, deep learning, optimization.
  • Strong fluency in Python and SQL; experience with modern ML and data infrastructure.
  • Fluency in marketing economics (CAC, LTV/CAC, payback, ROAS) and how models connect to budget allocation.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership: setting direction across teams, mentoring senior and junior DS, and influencing leadership.
  • Clear communication with audiences from engineers to executives.

Preferred Expertise:

  • Causal ML, uplift modeling, and integrating predictive models with experimentation and incrementality measurement.
  • Contextual bandits, reinforcement learning, or other sequential decision methods for bidding, budget pacing, or next-best-action.
  • Hands-on experience with paid media platforms (e.g., Amazon, Google Ads, Meta), including value-based bidding and conversion signals, or with lifecycle channels (email, push).
  • Marketplace, travel, subscription, or e-commerce domain experience.
  • LLM and agentic AI applications in marketing or measurement, including evaluation of agent outputs.
  • Publications, patents, or external presentations that show thought leadership in quantitative marketing and related fields.

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.Â 

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role youâre applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.Â 

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Â 

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits. Â 

Pay Range
$200,000â$242,000 USD

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.
